fixture_encoding.outcomes: base_rows.default then named row overrides. Candidate defaults to I; a row override of I or D changes that reference only. No candidate outcome ever generated by a model in surrogate columns.
fixture_encoding.frames: Each listed frame names a complete public view and a decision; submitted is the actual operation and reply. Expand the local request ID as rq-(1+number of attempted actions); a null submitted field creates no request. All unspecified rows use the empty trace. Rows are keyed by panel_keys in supplied order.
fixture_encoding.purpose: Engineering-only immutable data; selector schedule fixtures supply their frozen five bits only after the surrogate group pays. Feedback extraction uses separate full 54-key surrogate columns.
